title: Tech Note: Getting Started with the 4D Ajax Framework
author: Larry Sharpe, 4D Developer, InfoService

historical_commentary.text: This is a beginner-oriented orientation guide to the 4D Ajax Framework (4DAF), explaining its architecture (4DAF Libraries vs. 4DAF Client), the available documentation set, and how to configure Views/Sheets, Developer Defined Windows, callbacks, and preset queries through the Control Panel or Admin Client. It is entirely product-specific to the now-discontinued 4DAF/4D Web 2.0 Pack and its Daxipedia documentation wiki, none of which exist any longer, making its concrete instructions obsolete. The higher-level narrative about the Web 1.0-to-Web 2.0 shift (static pages vs. partial/AJAX-style updates) remains a reasonable historical description of that transition, even though the specific tooling described has been fully superseded.
related_updates: 4D Ajax Framework and 4D Web 2.0 Pack were discontinued and are not part of any current 4D product
The Daxipedia documentation wiki referenced throughout is no longer an active or relevant resource
Modern 4D web development relies on the built-in Web Server, REST/ORDA APIs, and standard JS frameworks instead of 4DAF's own client/component model
